summary.en: A line fills its bar, runs out of the scene, the camera follows it one frame to the right, and it turns its corners to draw the frame the next picture appears in; one line, no cut.
summary.zh: 进度条走满，线冲出卡缘，镜头跟着线横移一屏，线在移动中直角拐弯围出下一场的画框，框闭合后画面在框里出现；全程一条线、没有切。

fits: Process → result (render → film, plan → shipped); a title sequence in a graphic, poster style; one continuous gesture between two places.
notFor: Scenes with no line or rule to start from; fast films (it takes about 9 beats); vertical layouts.

intent.en: No cut at all: one line, born from something finishing, leads the eye across to the next place and draws its frame, so two scenes read as one gesture.
intent.zh: 根本不切：一条从“走完了”的东西里长出的线牵着视线走到下一处，并画出它的框，两场读作一笔。

content.en: Wraps two scenes: the first must have a line to start from (a progress bar, an underline, a rule) and its position; the second picture goes inside the frame the line draws.
content.zh: 包住两场：第一场要有能起线的图形（进度条、下划线、分隔线）并给出位置；第二场的画面放进线画出的框里。

fits.zh: 过程 → 结果（渲染 → 成片、计划 → 上线）；平面海报风的片头；两处之间一气呵成的动作。

notFor.zh: 没有现成线条可起的场景；快节奏的片子（约 9 拍）；竖版构图。

pairs.note: keep the same line weight if both appear

en: The line must grow out of something already on screen (a bar finishing, an underline drawn); a line from nowhere reads as a screensaver.
A signature move: once per film.
Keep one line language across the film (same weight and feel as other drawn lines).
zh: 线必须从画面里已有的东西长出来（进度条走满、下划线画完）；凭空起线像屏保。
全片线条语言一致（和其他描线同粗细同手感）。

upstream.name: 线条接力转场
upstream.summary: 线条接力横移转场——场景 A 的进度条延伸出画，镜头跟线横移，线在移动中拐角围出场景 B 的卡框，全程无剪切
upstream.use: 两个有图形亲缘的场景之间（进度条→卡框、下划线→图表轴）；一支片子的招牌转场位，Catch Me If You Can 片头的图形接力

overlaps.note: a rail that presses the next card in; no camera move
a line linking two things on one screen
